slice: NW ROUTE CORRIDOR — the stops BETWEEN central Saigon and Tây Ninh: Củ Chi town → Trảng Bàng → Gò Dầu/Hậu Nghĩa → Tây Ninh city / Núi Bà Đen / Dầu Tiếng. Kept SEPARATE from SOURCES_HCMC.json and the other HCMC slices.

outlets.name: Việt Nam News (VNS)
outlets.note: English daily of the Vietnam News Agency. Anchors Bò Tơ Củ Chi (restaurant review), the Bà Đen cable car, Ma Thiên Lãnh and Dầu Tiếng Reservoir.

outlets.name: VietnamPlus (Vietnam News Agency, English)
outlets.note: Official VNA multilingual outlet. Bánh tráng phơi sương heritage + the Tây Bổ Đà Sơn Buddha statue.

outlets.name: VietnamPlus (second article)
outlets.note: Second VNP piece corroborating the Lady-Buddha statue (records/dimensions).

outlets.name: VietnamNet
outlets.note: Major national news portal; Tây Ninh đặc sản coverage (bánh canh Trảng Bàng, muối tôm).

outlets.name: Nhân Dân Online (English)
outlets.note: Communist Party daily, English edition; corroborates the Guinness cable-car-station record.

outlets.name: Sài Gòn Giải Phóng (SGGP English Edition)
outlets.note: HCMC party daily English edition; orchard-tourism feature covering Trung An/Củ Chi.

outlets.name: Người Lao Động (nld.com.vn)
outlets.note: Major HCMC daily; khoai mì Củ Chi feature.

outlets.name: Doanh Nhân Sài Gòn
outlets.note: HCMC business daily; khoai mì Củ Chi cultural piece.

outlets.name: Saigoneer
outlets.note: Leading Saigon English-language culture/food outlet; bánh tráng artisan mini-doc used for the Trảng Bàng dew-paper craft.

outlets.name: Guinness World Records
outlets.note: Lone-authority-OK. Certifies the largest cable-car station (Ba Den) and is cited for the bronze-Buddha record.

outlets.name: Wikipedia (English)
outlets.note: Full articles used for Dầu Tiếng Lake and Cu Chi Wildlife Rescue Station.

outlets.name: Tây Ninh Provincial Tourism (official)
outlets.note: Provincial tourism authority; Ma Thiên Lãnh listing.

outlets.name: Lonely Planet
outlets.note: Cu Chi Wildlife Rescue Station listing.

outlets.name: Vietnam Airlines Travel Guide
outlets.note: National-carrier destination guide; secondary corroboration for Tây Ninh specialties (muối tôm, ốc núi). Not a lone recommender.

outlets.name: VinWonders (Vingroup) Wonderpedia
outlets.note: Vingroup travel content; lists the named bánh canh Trảng Bàng houses and Củ Chi orchards. Corroborating, not a lone recommender.

outlets.name: Sun World Ba Den Mountain (official)
outlets.note: Operator of the Bà Đen complex; used only as corroboration for the local food canon it documents, never as the recommender.

outlets.name: Sun Paradise Land (Tây Ninh)
outlets.note: Tây Ninh travel content; vegetarian-cluster corroboration near Bà Đen.

outlets.name: Mytour.vn
outlets.note: Travel listing site; Long Hoa Market / Cao Đài culture. Secondary only.

outlets.name: Viet Bao (English)
outlets.note: Vietnamese news portal English edition; Tây Ninh vegetarian-cuisine feature.

outlets.name: Mia.vn Cẩm nang du lịch
outlets.note: Popular VN travel-guide site; names the specific bánh canh Trảng Bàng and bò tơ Củ Chi houses. Secondary, corroborating.

outlets.name: Crystal Bay
outlets.note: Travel operator listicle; corroborates the ranked bánh canh Trảng Bàng shops. Secondary.

outlets.name: Traveloka Explore (Culinary)
outlets.note: OTA content; bánh tráng phơi sương process. Secondary.

outlets.name: Pasgo Blog
outlets.note: Restaurant-booking blog; Tây Ninh specialties incl. ốc núi. Secondary.

outlets.name: Lữ Hành Việt Nam
outlets.note: VN travel blog; bánh tráng muối ớt/tôm Tây Ninh. Secondary.
